fusions.name: Recited Mouthful
fusions.desc: Takes a mouthful from every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 6 damage and restores 3 health to you. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Practised Final Word
fusions.desc: Speaks a strike at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and ignores its resistances. Its damage rises 7% for every tenth of your own health already lost (max 35%).

fusions.name: Another Lap
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Circling Recital
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. You also regenerate 0.4 health a second, permanently.
